name: code-siren-ide
description: Code Siren IDE — AI-powered development environment. This is a monorepo root; it has no shared runtime dependencies. Install and run from server/ and app/ separately (see README.md Quick Start).

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix app install
scripts.ci:all: npm --prefix server ci && npm --prefix app ci
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test -- --exclude tests/unit/run-tests.test.ts --exclude tests/unit/ghost-remediation.test.ts --exclude tests/unit/playwright-client.test.ts --exclude tests/unit/workflow-runner.test.ts --exclude tests/unit/upr-phase1-step2b-abortsignal-cap.test.ts && npm --prefix app test
scripts.test:server: npm --prefix server test -- --exclude tests/unit/run-tests.test.ts --exclude tests/unit/ghost-remediation.test.ts --exclude tests/unit/playwright-client.test.ts --exclude tests/unit/workflow-runner.test.ts --exclude tests/unit/upr-phase1-step2b-abortsignal-cap.test.ts
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix app run typecheck
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix app run build
scripts.verify:app: npm --prefix app run typecheck && npm --prefix app run lint:strict && npm --prefix app test && npm --prefix app run build
